prompt: Create an original 120 second deep instrumental house instrumental composition for travel montage, walking and urban exploration. Mood: moving, bright, relaxed. Instruments: warm synth chords, four-on-floor drums, sub bass. Style: consistent dance groove, small filter movement, no large drop. Tempo approximately 130 BPM; E minor. Main idea: an ascending fourth answered by a stepwise descent. Use a forward-moving motif and recurring short instrumental answers. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:40] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:40-01:20] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:20-02:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 02:00.

description.en: A vibrant electronic track featuring a driving synth bassline, energetic electronic drums, and uplifting synth melodies and arpeggios. It has a modern, upbeat feel with a consistent groove.
description.zh: 一首充满活力的电子音乐，具有强劲的合成器贝斯线、动感的电子鼓点以及振奋人心的合成器旋律和琶音。整体感觉现代而欢快，节奏感十足。
